transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. Lee. What brings you in to see me today?

I... I don't know, really. Just haven't been feeling like myself lately. I used to do things—hiking, coaching, playing guitar... but I stopped. I don't even call people back anymore. Some days I just sit in my rental for hours. I know there are things I should be doing, but... I just can't make myself start.
How long have you been feeling this way—no longer enjoying things and not wanting to do your usual activities?
...Probably about a year and two months. That's when I... when I moved into this smaller rental. It was right after the divorce. Just feels like things have been unraveling since then.
Over this past year and two months, has your low mood and lack of interest been present almost every day, or have there been stretches of weeks when you felt back to your normal self?
...I don't really know. I don't keep track of the days like that. It all just... kind of runs together, I guess. I couldn't tell you if there were normal weeks.
Before this past year, had you ever gone through a period—weeks or months—where you felt this same kind of low mood and loss of interest, even back in earlier parts of your life?
...No. Not that I remember. Just... this past year, really.
Over this past year, have you noticed changes in your sleep—such as trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?
...Sleep is just sleep. I don't know. I haven't really paid attention to it.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over this past year—eating significantly more or less than usual?
...I haven't noticed anything. I just eat when I eat. I don't really step on a scale or anything like that.
Over this past year, have you had thoughts of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or thoughts of death or suicide?
...No. I don't really... think about that kind of stuff. Just... no.
Over this past year, have you noticed feeling unusually tired or low on energy, even when you haven't been especially active?
...Not really. I mean, I'm just... going through the day. I don't feel any more tired than usual. Just regular tired, I guess.

Would you say this low mood and loss of interest happens mainly when you're thinking about the divorce or your situation, or do you feel this way pretty much all the time, no matter what you're doing or thinking about?
...I don't really know. I don't think about the divorce much. Things are just... the way they are. I just feel the same mostly. Just... all the time, I guess.
Over this past year, have you noticed trouble concentrating or making everyday decisions, like at work or in daily tasks?
...No. Not really. I just... do what I need to do. I don't think it's hard to focus or anything. Just... normal.
Over this past year, would you say you've been feeling sad, empty, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?
...No. I don't think so. I'm just... here. I don't really feel much of anything, to be honest. Just... getting by.
Did these feelings start right around the time of your divorce and move, or did they begin some time before or after that event?
...I guess it was around then. After the divorce. I moved into a smaller rental... maybe a year and two months ago, I think. Things just started... unraveling, I suppose, since then.
...I'm not really sure what you're asking me. I don't have anything else to add to that.

...It's done. The paperwork and all that. I don't... we don't talk anymore. It's just over.
...I don't really know what else you want me to say about it. That's it.
Now that the divorce is finalized and settled, have you noticed any improvement in how you're feeling, or does it feel just the same as before?
...I haven't really noticed. It just... feels the same, I guess. Nothing's different.

...I don't know. I'm not really sure what else you want me to say about it. There's just... nothing else.
